name: Uno
summary: Shedding card game where players match color or number to discard their hand, first to 500 points wins.
rules_text: Use 108 Uno cards. Each player is dealt 7 cards. Flip one card to start discard pile. Players in turn order must play a card matching color, number, or symbol of top discard, or play a Wild. If unable or unwilling, draw one card and play it if possible, otherwise pass. Skip skips next player, Reverse reverses order, Draw 2 makes next player draw 2 and lose turn, Wild lets you choose color, Wild Draw 4 lets you choose color and makes next player draw 4 but may only be legally played if you have no card matching current color; if challenged and illegal, you draw 4, otherwise challenger draws 6. Before playing your second-to-last card you must say Uno, or draw 4 if caught. Round ends when one player empties hand. Scores: number cards face value, action cards 20, wilds 50. First to 500 wins.
rating_reason: Classic hidden-hand shedding game, strategic sequential choice.
